I added `latestForCustomer(String customerId)` to `OrderFacade`. It returns an `OrderLookup`, which reports whether the customer has any orders. The full test suite passes.

- **`orders/api/OrderLookup.java`** (new): a record with `found` and `order`, plus `found(...)` and `notFound()` factories. I used this instead of `Optional` because the architecture test enforces ADR 0010, which says API methods return a `<Thing>Lookup` record.
- **`OrderFacade` / `OrderService`**: the new method returns the summary of the most recently placed order, or `notFound()` when the customer has none. It is read-only and transactional, like `summary`.
- **`OrderRepository.latestFor`**: picks the matching order with the greatest `placedAt`.
- **`ShopFlowTest`**: a new test checks that a customer with no orders gets `found() == false`, and that the order with the latest `placedAt` wins even when it wasn't placed last.

Callers should check `found()` before reading `order()`, since `order()` is null when nothing was found.
